test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall support the validation of project-specific critical extensions within the leaf certificate.
(extension value is the project identifier; certificate is accepted)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Read the certificate extensions of the certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. PENDING: X-e OID certificate + trigger
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows "X509v3 Certificate Policies: critical" and a "Policy:" line with the OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.57872.<…>
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. PENDING: X-h log keyword
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
